title: Awaaz Do Akbar
body:
Awaaz do akbar..(6)
Aawaaz do ay laal dikhai nahi deta
akbar mujhe ab kuch bhi sujhai nahi deta
tum mujhko sadaa dete raho ay mere dilbarr...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai jab bhi tumhe dekhta milta tha sahara
is zulm ki duniya me koi to hai hamara
ab tum bhi juda hogaye ham shakle payambarr...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Har maa ki tamanna hai ke shadi ho pisar ki
laau mai dulhan chaand si ronak badhe ghar ki
layla ko khabar gham ki sunaunga mai kyu karr..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sughra hai madine me yahi aas lagaye
bhai mera karbal se watan laut ke aaye
beta teri furqat me guzar jaegi khwahar..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tum jaate ho miljaega har ghamse efaaka
reh jaega ek baap museebat me akela
ruk jaye ajal dekhlu bete ko mai jee bharr..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Majboor tha jo de na saka tujhko mai pani
ab mujhko rulaegi teri tashna dahani
se'raab karenge tujhe ab saqiye kausarr..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Allah kisi baap ko ye ghum na dikhaye
tanha wo jawaa'n laal ki mayyat ko uthaye
ab dekho meri jung ko ham shakle payambarr...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aao ki koi naasir e shabbir nahi hai
abbbas nahi asghar e besheer nahi hai
mazloom bulata hai kaha ho mere yaawarr..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Jaata hu'n mai maqtal ko mujhe khod pinha do
shano ko pakadlo mujhe ghode pe bitha do
is baap ko dete the sahara tumhe aksarr..
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Jis waqt kaha nauha 'zameer e razawi' ne
di haath uthakar ye dua bint e ali ne
aameen kaho isse ho khushnood payambarr...
Awaaz do akbar..(4)
